build_tokenizer: build a tokenizer using build_tokenizer with name bytes sp tiktoken or mock
encode_text_byte: encode text to byte tokens using ByteTokenizer encode with optional bos and eos
encode_text_sentencepiece: encode text to tokens using SentencePieceTokenizer with a model file path
encode_text_tiktoken: encode text to tokens using TikTokenTokenizer with a tiktoken model path
get_token_offsets: get token substrings and byte offsets from text using get_token_offsets method
